lines.text: The root is Ject! Reject, project, inject.
Did you know? Ject is Latin for throw.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus throw?

words.ex: The company rejected my first application.
Our group project is about renewable energy.
The nurse injected the vaccine into my arm.

publish.title: Ject root: reject, project and inject
publish.value: Ject comes from Latin "jacere" (to throw). Words: reject, project and inject. reject = re + ject; project = pro + ject; inject = in + ject.
